name: Raycast
soft_passes: #6 red-monochrome palette is economical, but the accent is spread across glow/wordmark/halo rather than reserved for one focal element
#7 white glyph on charcoal is high-contrast; but the red-on-dark wordmark is weak figure-ground
#8 layers order sensibly back-to-front with no z-fighting
#11 commits to a nameable dark-neon device (its one genuine virtue, though derivative web-neon)
failures: #1 baked grey bevel frame + inner-panel border fights the system squircle mask; render sits squircle-on-white, not full-bleed
#2 dominant glyph crammed into top-right corner near safe-zone edge, not optically centred; wordmark fills the bottom band
#3 solid-fill silhouette is a square + corner tick + text blob — two competing masses, no single nameable subject
#4 at 16px the 'raycast' wordmark collapses to an unreadable pink smear and the glyph becomes a red dot
#5 bottom red neon glow vs white glyph specular = glow-based web light, not one coherent mac top-down source
#9 cross-idiom mashup (skeuo bevel frame + web neon glow + baked text) belongs to no single mac era
#10 composition depends on the dark panel + red glow; glyph and wordmark would vanish under clear/tinted/light renders
#12 a literal 'raycast' wordmark is baked into the artwork

palette.background: flat charcoal #1D1D1D panel (ramp #282626->#1D1D1D) inside a grey bevel frame #6D6D6D, with a red bottom glow #E06364 bleeding to #2F1613

light_model: omnidirectional red neon glow rising from the bottom edge plus white specular on the angular glyph; a web-graphic glow light, not the mac top-down bake — mixed and uncanonical
layer_stack: white pointer/loupe glyph + red halo + diagonal streaks, top-right (front)
devices: neon glow rim (red light from bottom edge, bleeding up the sides)
baked grey bevel frame fighting the system mask
corner-crammed pointer glyph with diagonal motion streaks
rhymes_hint: dark-neon dev-tool / gaming badges (glow-rimmed charcoal, single saturated hue) — terminal-hacker x retro-neon family, NOT the Big-Sur mac-icon family
notes: CRITICAL: icon.webp is a 102x102px web thumbnail that CONTRADICTS Raycast's real shipping mark. The same source's cover.png shows the true icon: a pure-black squircle with a single centred silver/chrome geometric pointer, NO wordmark, NO glow (clean Big-Sur-unified minimalist, would score ~10-11/12). The served render is almost certainly corrupted/alternate/AI-upscaled. All pixel values are (estimated) from a degraded thumbnail. Score reflects the artifact as served; do NOT promote any of this to icon canon and do NOT treat it as evidence of Raycast's actual icon. Re-digest if a clean high-res render becomes available. Mask observation: no true alpha (corners baked white), so full-bleed/mask behaviour is unverifiable.
